correctness.rationale: The octagon has a=sqrt2-1, vertices (±1,±a),(±a,±1), and dual norm max(|p|+a|q|,a|p|+|q|). By dihedral symmetry only interior edge x=(1,t), |t|<a, and corner x=(1,a) occur. Interior-edge Birkhoff directions y=(0,±1) have d=1/(1+a|t|)≥1/(1+a²). Corner normal cones yield y=(r,-1)/m(r), 0≤r≤1, m=1 for r≤a and (1+r)/sqrt2 for r≥a. Exact quotient distance d=(1+ar)/(m(r)(1+a²))≥1/(1+a²); equality at r=0, r=1. The radical identity 1/(1+a²)=(2+sqrt2)/4 and eps²=(5-2sqrt2)/8 was independently confirmed symbolically. Exhaustive edge/corner proof is analytical.
residual_risks: Finite-dimensional real regular octagon only; no all-2n-gon claim.

evidence: Prior exact-octagon theorem gives the full sharp constant. The general arXiv theorem supplies only nonquantitative D-existence.
